name: cell-lean
description: Minimal peak memory variant of cell-fused (the same computation, csdid 1.81/2.0.1 rules with every option of the combined task) in NumPy only: per-cohort shared/warm-started Newton fits with row-chunked weighted Gram matrices; a pass over units in blocks of one cohort with 512 KB working matrices, the cells' sums and a small Gram matrix of the aggregate influence functions instead of per-unit arrays; bootstrap in tiles of at most 4 MB of draws with BLAS products and np.partition order statistics; free pages returned to the OS. Threads: BLAS only.
